messages:
maria: Quick sync — LumaHealth private VPC weekly pulse. Wanted to surface region-by-region uptime, KMS/HSM oddities, and a couple onboarding/renewal signals. TL;DR: overall good, slight eu-west KMS latency spike this morning, usage up, spend trending as expected.

devon: Can you drop the metrics you have? uptime %, avg p50/p95 latency, error rate, and spend delta from last week?

maria: Sure — pulling the summary now. short version:
- us-east-1: uptime 99.99%, avg p50 38ms, p95 122ms, 0.03% 5xx
- eu-west-1: uptime 99.88%, avg p50 46ms, p95 315ms, 0.6% 5xx (spike earlier at 08:12 UTC)
- ap-southeast-1: uptime 99.95%, avg p50 52ms, p95 140ms, 0.1% 5xx
Usage: tokens/day +12% week-over-week (integration tests + prod ramp)
Spend: platform spend +9% (more sustained batch runs)

raj: saw the eu-west blip in our alerting — is that the KMS HSM path failing or a network issue? logs?

allegra: I pulled the KMS logs for eu-west around 08:10-08:20 UTC. We had ~180ms median KMS call latency, occasional 1.2s tails. No HSM failover events recorded. Looks like brief encryption-decryption queueing when key cache miss rate rose.

maria: Relevant snippet from the KMS agent output (08:12):
```
[kms-agent] WARN 08:12:07 RequestTimeout: encrypt request delayed 1200ms key=key-ax3
[kms-agent] INFO 08:12:12 Recovered from transient network error
```

tim: Did customer rotate keys yesterday? rotation + cold cache could explain misses.

maria: They rotated on Tuesday evening in eu-west as part of onboarding. We saw higher-than-normal key cache misses starting today and then decay over ~20 minutes.

raj: Network notes: no BGP flaps, infra reports small spike in packet retransmits to the KMS cluster at 08:10. Might be transient congestion in the region. I've attached the router-sum: 0.4% retransmits at peak.

devon: Are we confident HSM-backed keys are safe? Any risk to their renewal or compliance red flags?

hsm-bot: hsm-bot: key key-ax3 status=ACTIVE provider=HSM region=eu-west-1 last-rotate=2026-03-10 rotation-success=true audits=clean

allegra: HSM checks look normal. No failed attestations. Recommend we enable a short-term cache warming on their dedicated pool for next 48h to reduce cache miss tails.

maria: Action items:
- raj: file a short network ticket to monitor retransmits in eu-west for next 48h (owner: @raj)
- allegra: enable proactive key cache warming for LumaHealth's pool (owner: @allegra)
- devon + tim: confirm onboarding playbook note about key rotation timing and include cache-warm tip (owner: @devon,@tim)

tim: I'll update the onboarding doc and ping the customer with a recommended maintenance window for future rotations.

devon: Small renewal signal: usage +12% is good, but spend +9% with higher tails may trigger cost concerns. I'll draft a brief note for AMs highlighting options (autoscale buffers, cache-warming, short quantization profile for batch jobs).

maria: Thanks — non-blocking but put on our radar for the renewal healthcheck. Anything else?

raj: I'll set the eu-west telemetry alert to lower threshold for retransmits and keep you updated.

maria: Great. If no objections I'll close this thread and follow up in the customer weekly with a one-paragraph note and the action items. :+1:

devon: :thumbsup:

allegra: :white_check_mark:

maria: End of thread."
